task: Arcanea Visual Encyclopedia and 100-image production wave
surface: /gallery plus the Resonant Kinforms and Wave 02 image collections
audience: Arcanea creators, readers, art directors, and the private review operator
references: Arcanea interface tokens and editorial typography

direction.keep: Original tactile 3D beings, material-specific Gate identity, mature emotional clarity, useful story roles, inspectable provenance
direction.avoid: Franchise mimicry, toy-plastic surfaces, collectible-monster framing, generic fantasy armor, node-cloud decoration, public destructive controls
direction.signature: Engineered companionship meets a mythic field encyclopedia
direction.system: Thirty foundation masters plus ten Gate-led batches of ten new records

asset_quality.why_premium: Each master is prompt-directed from a named role, gift, cost, material system, camera, emotion, and canon boundary, then inspected and scored before approval.

artifacts.kind: one hundred inspected Foundation through Source image masters
exact one hundred-record master atlas plus ten Gate boards

checks.name: asset-tier
checks.evidence: Custom generated 3D masters are Tier B.

checks.name: export-inspection
checks.evidence: All one hundred masters across Batches 01–10 were opened and visually inspected; eleven failed or superseded continuity studies were separated.

checks.name: canon-boundary
checks.evidence: All generated additions remain proposal lore and reference locked Gate relationships without promotion.

checks.name: infographic-integrity
checks.evidence: Validator confirms 100 unique dossiers, ten Gate boards, exact category and Gate totals, valid master references, and 100 unique atlas images; representative dossier types and the Source board were raster-inspected.

checks.name: catalog-contract
checks.evidence: Standalone validation confirms 130 unique records, exact category and batch totals, 560 valid relationship references, 301 unique undirected graph edges, and 130 unique generated-master checksum receipts.

checks.name: media-intake-packet
checks.evidence: The offline packet builder and independent validator re-read all 130 PNG masters and verified 320,204,312 bytes, unique hashes, dimensions, deterministic client correlation IDs, exact Control Worker ingest headers and content-addressed expectations, provenance bounds, and release holds with zero cloud writes.

checks.name: publication-boundary
checks.evidence: The gallery consumes only a same-origin, registry-confirmed publication receipt carrying source/rendition checksums plus registry, rendition, rights, and publication-review evidence IDs. Behavioral tests accept valid hydration and reject duplicate, checksum-drifted, off-origin, and evidence-incomplete receipts.

checks.name: gallery-context
checks.evidence: The canonical Vercel project uses Node 24.x, but dependencies are absent in this worktree and the machine preflight holds local builds and browser loops; runtime inspection is deferred.

checks.name: shared-media-hosting
checks.evidence: Agentic Ops PR #14 and Arcanea PR #241 are draft boundaries; dedicated shared Supabase, R2, Workers, rights review, publication review, and arcanea.ai attachment remain unprovisioned.

score.note: The generated-media and infographic package clears the 26/30 ship threshold; continue iterating on the overall gallery until desktop/mobile runtime inspection and the hosting boundary are approved. Every Gate batch averages above 28/30; Source closes at 29.6/30.
